newsitem.title: USA: JWCharles files for Americas Growth swap.
newsitem.headline: JWCharles files for Americas Growth swap.

text.p: JWCharles Financial Services Inc said Monday it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission as part of its offer to exchange shares of its common stock for shares of Americas Growth Fund Inc.
JWCharles said it intends to exchange 0.418 shares of its common stock for each share of Americas Growth. JWCharles currently owns about 25 percent of Americas Growth outstanding shares.

The company said the exchange ratio is based in part on Americas Growth's net asset value per share, which was $3.74 per share at March 31. The ratio may be adjusted upward, but not downward, if the net asset value increases before the expiration of the exchange offer, provided it is made and consummated.
The registration statement has not yet become effective, the company said.

JWCharles also said its board of directors has approved the discretionary repurchase of up to 300,000 shares of its common stock, or about 8 percent of shares outstanding. The shares will be repurchased periodically in the open market, as warranted by prevailing price and supply.
